INTRODUCTION
This Final Environmental Statement is written for the proposed 1.5 mile Airport Spur freeway facility on new location within the recommended Corridor #5, connecting Interstate Route I-94 (North-South Freeway) to the airport terminal facilities of General Mitchell Field.
The proposed highway project was originally scheduled for an opening date in 1971 but construction was delayed to 1973 so that the selected freeway alignment would be compatible with the long range General Mitchell Field's Terminal Master Plan.
A corridor location public hearing for this project and public presentation of the alternate locations was held or March 25, 1969. The date of location approval from the Federal Highway Administration was August 13, 1969.
In September 1969 the State of Wisconsin advertised in several newspapers a notice of opportunity for a design public hearing for the proposed Airport Spur but no requests were received. Final design approval was received from the Federal Highway Administration on November 13, 1970.
On October 11, 1972 the Wisconsin Highway Commission directed its staff to prepare an environmental impact statement for the proposed project.
On June 19, 1973, the Draft Environmental Impact Statement was made available to the public and was circulated to the required federal and state agencies. On July 11, 1974, an environmental public hearing was held.
